steps.name: Settled volume through Intents
steps.source: DefiLlama dexs/near-intents dailyVolume, a pass-through of dune.near.dataset_near_intents_metrics

steps.name: Gross swap fees
steps.source: DefiLlama fees/near-intents dailyFees: protocol fee plus affiliate fees across integrators (Dune datasets)

steps.name: Net revenue captured by NEAR (NEAR/wNEAR swept into revenue wallets)
steps.source: DefiLlama dailyRevenue: TRANSFER and wrap.near inflows to fefundsadmin, 1csfundsadmin and buybacks wallets, internal hops excluded
steps.note: sweeps are periodic, so a day's receipts can exceed that day's fees

steps.name: Revenue labelled as buyback (dates on or after 2026-02-23)
steps.status: classified by an adapter date rule, not by transaction
steps.source: DefiLlama dailyHoldersRevenue = dailyRevenue on or after BUYBACK_START

steps.name: Executed purchases: NEAR settled by intents.near into buybacks.multisignature.near
steps.status: observed (NearBlocks receipts, valued at the daily NEAR price)
steps.note: 3081 swap-output transfers from 2026-03-18 to 2026-11-01; a further 510,068 NEAR arrived from the other revenue wallets (treasury moves, excluded here as the adapter excludes them) and 8,293 NEAR from other accounts. The wallet was created 2026-03-18, after the adapter's buyback start 2026-02-23, so labelled revenue before that date cannot be matched to this wallet

steps.name: Destination of purchased tokens
steps.status: observed balance (held in the multisig; no burn observed)
steps.note: balance at the snapshot divided by all inbound NEAR before the cutoff; outbound transfers before the cutoff: 12,025 NEAR. Holding is not supply destruction

dilution.measure: total supply change: protocol issuance net of gas burn; unlocks of already-issued tokens are not dilution of supply

circulating_supply_field.note: constant in the NearBlocks snapshot over the window, so it is not used

dilution.note: buybacks are held, not burned, so they do not reduce supply and are not netted twice: issuance is counted once here and buybacks once above

dominant_assumption.method: one at a time: each input moved from its base to its adverse value, others held at base; ranked by the absolute change in net yield

what_weakens_the_thesis: issuance above buyback accrual in every scenario means settlement growth does not translate into net token accrual; a fall in volume or capture, or an allocation decision away from buybacks, removes the accrual entirely

status_legend.observed: read from a public source and reproducible from the committed snapshot
status_legend.classified: a rule applied by the data provider
status_legend.inferred: computed from observed items under a stated assumption
status_legend.unavailable: not obtainable without credentials or absent on-chain
